fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock rose 2.7% in pre-market trading bolstered by Nvidia's strong results, recovering part of a 13% decline over the past two trading days.
fields.summary_ko.1: Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion (exceeding market expectations) and EPS of $2.68 (vs. expected $2.47), confirming sustained AI infrastructure demand.
fields.summary_ko.2: AMD completed the acquisition of AI inference chip design company Taalas for approximately $2.9 billion, integrating 'Hardcore Models' technology to strengthen competitiveness in the AI accelerator market.
